name: labelSets
description: Distinct combinations of a set of log fields over the indexing lookback, one row per combination, used to index objects

getArgs.value: {{dataSource[pack] === false ? '_time:1s "__squaredup_disabled__":* | stats count() hits' : '_time:' + (dataSource.indexLookback || '1h') + ' ' + (match || required.split(',').map(f => '"' + f.trim() + '":*').join(' ')) + ' | stats by (' + (labels + (extraLabels ? ',' + extraLabels : '')).split(',').map(f => f.trim()).filter(f => f && f !== '-').map(f => '"' + f + '"').join(', ') + ') count() hits'}}

ui.name: pack
ui.label: Index pack
ui.help: The **Objects to index** option that enables this label set, e.g. `indexK8s`.

ui.name: labels
ui.label: Fields
ui.help: Comma-separated log fields to group by, in the same order as **Property names**; `-` for a property this convention has no field for (e.g. the cluster), which then comes from the **Default cluster name**.

ui.name: keys
ui.label: Property names
ui.help: Comma-separated property names for each label, in the same order as **Labels**.

ui.name: required
ui.label: Required fields
ui.help: Comma-separated fields that must be present for a log to count.

ui.name: nameKey
ui.label: Name property
ui.help: The property whose value is used as the object name.

ui.name: aliases
ui.label: Alias label sets
ui.help: `|`-separated alternative field names for the same properties (`-` for not present). Used to build a scoping filter that also matches other field conventions.

ui.name: match
ui.label: Series selector override
ui.help: Optional LogsQL filter to use instead of requiring the **Required fields**.

ui.name: extraLabels
ui.label: Extra labels
ui.help: Comma-separated labels stored as properties but not part of the object identity, e.g. `service.namespace`.

ui.name: extraKeys
ui.label: Extra property names
ui.help: Property names for **Extra labels**, in the same order.
